# Subscribe to Vault security notifications (CVEs) 

Stay informed about official HashiCorp security advisories and CVE disclosures
affecting Vault by subscribing to notifications on the
[HashiCorp Discuss](https://discuss.hashicorp.com) forum with the `security-vault`
tag.


## Before you start

- **You must have a valid email address** to create a Discuss account and to
  receive notifications.


## Step 1: Create a HashiCorp Discuss account

You must sign into a HashiCorp Discuss account to subscribe to notifications.

1. Visit [https://discuss.hashicorp.com](https://discuss.hashicorp.com).

1. Click **Sign In** in the top-right corner of the page.

1. Click **Sign Up** on the sign-in screen.

1. Choose one of the following registration methods:

   - **Username and password** to create a Discuss-specific account.

   - **GitHub** to sign in using your existing GitHub account.

   - **HCP account** to sign in using your HashiCorp Cloud Platform credentials.

1. Review and accept the **Terms of Service** and **Privacy Policy**.

1. Complete the rest of the sign-up process.

1. Wait for an activation email from the HashiCorp Discuss site at the address
   you provided. Allow up to 10 minutes for delivery. 

1. Open the activation email and click the confirmation link to activate your
   account.


## Step 2: Go to the Vault security topic
 
Navigate to the [Vault security topic][discuss-security-vault] and sign in if
you have not already done so.

HashiCorp Discuss uses the `security-vault` tag to collect posts related to Vault
security topics, including CVE disclosures and security advisories published by
HashiCorp.

You can also submit questions about a specific security advisory, by posting a
reply in the relevant thread on Discuss or by contacting HashiCorp Support.


## Step 3: Subscribe to notifications

![Notification level menu](/img/subscribe-to-notifications.png)

1. On the `security-vault` tag page, locate the **bell icon** (&#128276;) near
   the top-right of the tag listing.

1. Click the bell icon to open the notification level menu.

1. Select the appropriate notification level from the available options. We
   recommend selecting **Watching** to ensure you receive all new security
   advisories as they are published.
   
| Level    | What you receive                                                                            |
| -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Watching | An email notification for every new post added under the tag. Recommended for CVE tracking. |
| Tracking | Notifications only when you are mentioned or someone replies to your post.                  |
| Normal   | No proactive notifications.                                                                 |
| Muted    | No notifications, even for direct replies.                                                  |


## Step 4: Confirm your notification settings

To verify that you can receive email notifications:

1. Click your **avatar or profile picture** in the top-right corner.

2. Select **Preferences** from the dropdown menu.

1. Go to **Emails** in the left-hand navigation.

2. Confirm that **"Email me when I..."** notification options are enabled.

3. Click **Save Changes** if you make any adjustments.

<Tip title="Adjust your notification level">

If you find you are receiving more notifications than expected, return to the
bell icon on the `security-vault` tag page, and change your notification level to
**Tracking**. To stop notifications entirely, select **Normal** or **Muted**.

</Tip>

## Troubleshooting

Issue                                               | Resolution
--------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
Did not receive the activation email                | Check your spam or junk folder. If you have not received the email after 10 minutes, click **Resend Activation Email** on the sign-in screen to retry.
Cannot find the bell icon                           | Make sure you are signed in. The notification bell is only visible to authenticated users.
Not receiving email notifications after subscribing | Confirm your email preferences and check that your email provider is not filtering Discuss messages to spam.
Unsure whether you are already subscribed           | Navigate to the [Vault security topic][discuss-security-vault] and check if the bell icon shows **Watching**.
